mapper.sql: c.choice_id, c.from_node_id, c.to_node_id, c.choice_text, c.condition_expr, c.sort_order, c.create_time, c.update_time, t.story_id AS to_node_story_id, t.node_text AS to_node_text, t.is_ending AS to_is_ending, t.is_start AS to_is_start
mapper.select: SELECT FROM story_choice c LEFT JOIN story_node t ON c.to_node_id=t.node_id WHERE c.choice_id=#{choiceId}
SELECT FROM story_choice c LEFT JOIN story_node t ON c.to_node_id=t.node_id WHERE c.from_node_id=#{fromNodeId} ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.choice_id
SELECT FROM story_choice c JOIN story_node f ON c.from_node_id=f.node_id LEFT JOIN story_node t ON c.to_node_id=t.node_id WHERE f.story_id=#{storyId} ORDER BY c.choice_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_choice (from_node_id, to_node_id, choice_text, condition_expr, sort_order) VALUES (#{fromNodeId},#{toNodeId},#{choiceText},#{conditionExpr},#{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE story_choice SET to_node_id=#{toNodeId}, choice_text=#{choiceText}, condition_expr=#{conditionExpr}, sort_order=#{sortOrder} WHERE choice_id=#{choiceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM story_choice WHERE from_node_id=#{nodeId} OR to_node_id=#{nodeId}
